title: European Commission Launches Public Consultation on Future of Research Joint Undertakings
content:
The European Commission has opened a public consultation inviting researchers, industry players, national governments and citizens to help shape the next generation of European Partnerships in research and innovation.

Published by the Directorate-General for Research and Innovation on 10 July 2026, the consultation focuses on a future Single Basic Act (SBA) that would govern Joint Undertakings (JUs) and Article 185 initiatives, as well as broader thematic priorities for the European Partnership portfolio under Horizon Europe 2028-2034. The exercise is tied to preparations for the next EU Multiannual Financial Framework and the upcoming research and innovation programme.

The proposed SBA is designed to make Joint Undertakings more open and accessible, attract greater private investment, build critical mass around EU priorities, and better coordinate strategic efforts. A key aim is to align JUs with the European Competitiveness Fund so that EU funding supports the entire pipeline from basic research through to industrialisation and market uptake.
